assumptions.evidence: Whole GaussianLawDensity.lean has no section variables, local assumption instances, axioms or extra public premises. It calls singleBlockPrecision_regular hn hκ O; hr.1 is Hermitian and (hr.2 v).1 is v dot v <= v dot A_O v. Nonzero v is sent to WithLp.toLp 2 v; positivity of its true Euclidean norm squared gives v dot v>0 via EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq. Matrix.posDef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec then constructs hA internally. The blind reconstruction omits this proof history, but preserves the theorem assumptions exactly.

conclusion.evidence: Raw B.2 names p_O as density of N(0,A_O inverse); B.2.2 Gaussian-integration display explicitly carries sqrt(det A_O)/(2pi)^(n/2) and exponent -[kappa+1+4lambda-(kappa-1)U]||x||²/4, agreeing with Eq4. Current theorem has exactly the stated formula. ENNReal.ofReal is the conventional nonnegative density representation; hA ensures det>0, and exp and denominator are positive, so no truncation changes the real density. An equality of measures supplies literal density relative to canonical volume, rather than mere equality of normalization integrals.
